_note: Seed data for the Meal Group Management pages in kitchen-home.html, one key per page (route #meal-groups/<key>). Taken from the Dev system_local kitchen pages; anything added is marked SAMPLE DATA inside its entry. Edits are saved in the browser under antz.kitchen.mg.

keeper-areas._source: Dev system_local kitchen/keeper-areas.data.js + sites.data.js (unchanged). Enclosure strings: Name|Code|Species|Animals|Area; area.enclosures is rebuilt from the Area part, as in the source.

header.title: Keeper Areas
header.subtitle: group a section's enclosures into the areas a keeper works.

keeper-staff._source: Dev system_local kitchen/keeper-members.data.js (unchanged; coverage dropped, it is worked out from Keeper Areas as in the source)

header.title: Keeper Staff
header.subtitle: Zoo-scoped keeper and supervisor records posted to a site. These are not logins; assign them to sections and keeper areas under Keeper Areas.

packaging-list._source: Dev system_local kitchen/packaging-list.data.js (scopes, dietSchedules), sites.data.js (sites, sections, enclosures, supervisors), keeper-areas.data.js (areas). Captured rows are used as they are; the source works them out with packaging-engine.js. Species rows are [name, scientific, class, diet, noDietAnimals, section, keeperAreas, encl, animals]; enclosures are [name, area, species, animals].

packaging.enclosure: RnR site Transfer Section › RnR site TE

packing-stations._source: Dev system_local kitchen/packing-stations.data.js (packages per bench) and masters/packing-stations.data.js (stations, dialog rules). Bench names use a hyphen instead of the source en dash. RNR Kitchen is type Warehouse there, so the Kitchen select lists only central kitchen.

header.title: Packing Stations
header.subtitle: Pick a station to see everything it packs. Stations and packages are configured in Masters.

piece-weights._source: Dev system_local kitchen/piece-weights.data.js (unchanged; cut size "-" stored as null)

header.title: Piece Weights
header.subtitle: What one piece weighs, for every food a diet can ask for by the piece. A cut size with no weight cannot be converted to grams, so the forecast reports it rather than guessing.

wastage-setup._source: Dev system_local kitchen/wastage-setup.data.js (settings, history converted to dated snapshots as kitchen-store.js does on load), sites.data.js (sites, sections, enclosures as Name|Species|Animals|Area) and keeper-areas.data.js (area names, used only when the Keeper Areas page is not loaded). No additions.
